title: System
description: Text delivery, clipboard, autostart, and updates. Changes are saved automatically.
delivery.title: Text delivery
delivery.pasteMethod.label: How to paste the text
delivery.method.paste.label: Paste (Ctrl+V)
delivery.method.paste.hint: Default. Preserves accents and works in most apps.
delivery.method.ctrlShiftV.label: Paste in terminal (Ctrl+Shift+V)
delivery.method.ctrlShiftV.hint: For terminals that don't paste with Ctrl+V.
delivery.method.type.label: Type
delivery.method.type.hint: Types key by key, without using the clipboard. May get accents wrong on X11.
delivery.method.wtype.label: Type on Wayland (wtype)
delivery.method.wtype.hint: For Wayland sessions. Requires the wtype utility installed.
delivery.restoreClipboard.label: Restore the clipboard after pasting
delivery.restoreClipboard.info: By default the dictated text stays in the clipboard as a safety net. Restoring is best-effort — in slow apps the old text may come back too soon.
delivery.restoreClipboard.hint.enabled: Puts back whatever was in the clipboard before the dictation.
delivery.restoreClipboard.hint.disabled: Only applies to methods that use the clipboard (Paste / Ctrl+Shift+V).
startup.title: Startup
startup.launchAtLogin.label: Start with the system
startup.launchAtLogin.hint: Opens Wren automatically when the computer starts (stays in the tray).
updates.title: Updates
updates.description: Looks for a new version and installs it if there is one.
